SICK Scanner Import/Edit Field 
 
Summary:
This procedure should allow you to import a SICK project from an existing Scanner 
and download it to the new one. Once complete, small edits should be able to be 
made to get them to work correctly. 

Procedure: 
-Connect USB cable to scanner 
-Open SICK CDS program 
-Open pre-existing project if needed 
-Press F4 or Connect Project Button 
-Click continue and finish downloading project 
-Devices should be colored in and online now 
-If password is needed it is SICKSAFE 
View and Edit Scanner Fields 
-Right click Scanner Unit and Open Device Window 
-MAKE SURE SHOW/HIDE TREE VALUE IS ON, if it is not you cannot see any 
editable fields 
-Under Scanner Systems/Diagnostics/Data Recorder you should be able to see live 
values (Make sure your connected to target), this will show where the scanners 
are being “tripped” (See picture)

ContentBlocks.TextContent:
-Under Scanner Systems/Configuration/Field Sets (Host) or (Guest) you can make 
changes to the scanner field 
-After edits are complete select Transfer Configuration to Device and wait for 
device to reboot
